1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.VertexFanFigure
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FourRayPerimeter
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.FiveRayPerimeter
4 
5 /-! The actual surface angle is strictly below a full turn at every
6 vertex of the small polyhedra, including degrees three, four, and five. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.VertexFaceFan
9 
10 open Set Real InnerProductGeometry
11 
12 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {pole : P.Vertex} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
13   (fan : P.VertexFaceFan pole n)
14 
15 noncomputable def sectorAngle (i : Fin n) : ℝ :=
16   EuclideanGeometry.angle (fan.neighbor i : Space) pole (fan.neighbor (i + 1))
17 
18 noncomputable def totalAngle : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin n, fan.sectorAngle i
19 
20 theorem sectorAngle_pos (i : Fin n) : 0 < fan.sectorAngle i :=
21   EuclideanGeometry.angle_pos_of_not_collinear (fan.triangle_noncollinear i)
22 
23 theorem sectorAngle_lt_pi (i : Fin n) : fan.sectorAngle i < π :=
24   EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear (fan.triangle_noncollinear i)
25 
26 include fan in
27 theorem sector_count_bounds (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6) : 3 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 5 := by
28   classical
29   have count := Nat.card_congr fan.order
30   rw [Nat.card_fin] at count
31   have lower := P.edgeGraph_min_degree pole
32   simp only [← SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at lower
33   have upper := Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_of_notMem
34     (fun v : P.edgeGraph.neighborSet pole => v.val) Subtype.val_injective
35     (b := pole) (by
36       rintro ⟨v, same⟩
37       have edge : P.edgeGraph.Adj pole v.val := v.property
38       exact edge.ne same.symm)
39   have vertex_count : Fintype.card P.Vertex = P.vertices.card := by simp [Vertex]
40   rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, vertex_count] at upper
41   omega
42 
43 /-- The three- and four-ray bounds and the five-ray bound cover every possible degree. -/
44 theorem totalAngle_lt_two_pi (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
45     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
46       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) : fan.totalAngle < 2 * π := by
47   obtain ⟨normal, strict⟩ := P.vertex_strict_support pole.property
48   let figure : P.VertexFigure pole := ⟨normal, strict⟩
49   let height := -(innerSL ℝ figure.normal).toLinearMap
50   have levels (i : Fin n) : height (fan.ray figure i) = 1 := fan.ray_height figure i
51   have actual : fan.totalAngle = ∑ i : Fin n,
52       angle (fan.ray figure i) (fan.ray figure (i + 1)) := by
53     simp only [totalAngle, sectorAngle, fan.ray_angle]
54   rw [actual]
55   have counts := fan.sector_count_bounds size
56   have cases : n = 3 ∨ n = 4 ∨ n = 5 := by omega
57   rcases cases with rfl | rfl | rfl
58   · have bound := spherical_triangle_perimeter_lt height
59       (fan.ray figure 0) (fan.ray figure 1) (fan.ray figure 2)
60       (by rw [levels]; norm_num) (by rw [levels]; norm_num) (by rw [levels]; norm_num)
61     simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using bound
62   · choose side nonzero left right bounds _ using fan.ray_side_exists figure small_faces
63     let supported : FourRayFan := {
64       ray := fan.ray figure
65       distinct := fan.ray_injective figure
66       height := height
67       level := levels
68       spans := fan.rays_span figure
69       side := side
70       side_nonzero := nonzero
71       side_left := left
72       side_right := right
73       side_bound := bounds }
74     exact supported.sum_angles_lt_two_pi
75   · choose side nonzero left right bounds strict_sides using fan.ray_side_exists figure small_faces
76     let supported : FiveRayFan := {
77       ray := fan.ray figure
78       distinct := fan.ray_injective figure
79       height := height
80       level := levels
81       spans := fan.rays_span figure
82       side := side
83       side_nonzero := nonzero
84       side_left := left
85       side_right := right
86       side_bound := bounds
87       side_strict := strict_sides }
88     exact supported.sum_angles_lt_two_pi
89 
90 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.VertexFaceFan
